name: evasion-a-konigstein
description: Evasion à Königstein — site statique Astro (FR/RU) + préparation livre PDF/EPUB

scripts.book:pdf: npm run book:html && weasyprint dist/book/book.html dist/book/evasion-konigstein.pdf -u $(pwd)/public/ --optimize-images -j 80
scripts.book:epub: npm run book:html && pandoc dist/book/manuscript.md dist/book/metadata.yaml -o dist/book/evasion-konigstein.epub --toc --toc-depth=1 --resource-path=public --epub-cover-image=public/content/images/2020/04/konig.jpg
scripts.book: npm run book:pdf && npm run book:epub
